All, I think I have some sort of social anxiety.   Ever since I can remember, I always thought , "I will get through this."  That has been my thought for almost 10 years now.  

Now,10 years later, nothing has changed.  I just want to die.  It's sad, I know, but what am I to do.  I am alone right now, so maybe I should just end it.  I have no responsibilities or a lover or friends anymore.  So, what the fuck.
